scope: source-only; Research owner keyed retry idempotency

change.summary: Non-empty idempotency_key retries use a deterministic experiment id from sha256(parent, effective actor, key); under a pg advisory xact lock, the attempt insert (compare_and_set expected=None) and ticket link (CAS loop) share one experiments_store.transaction() conn, so replay returns the existing canonical record without mutation and failure rolls back both. No-key path unchanged. Replay first checks the hashed id, then scans experiments for an existing child with the same parent, effective actor and key (pre-upgrade numeric ids), so legacy children are reused without a duplicate child or ticket link. Reopen fix: unkeyed retry now inserts via compare_and_set and links the ticket via the same CAS loop in one transaction (no stale put overwriting a concurrent keyed link); a keyed deterministic-id hit must match parent/actor/key else ValueError (unrelated record never returned or mutated).

probe.before: FAIL (retry-before.log): 3 distinct attempt-2 records and 3 ticket links
probe.after: PASS exit 0: single retry id, 2 experiments, 2 ticket links
